ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in quadrilateral $ABCD$, $\angle C=110^\circ$, and the exterior angles adjacent to $\angle BAD$ and $\angle ABC$ are both $120^\circ$, then what is the value of $\angle \alpha$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since in quadrilateral ABCD, $\angle C=110^\circ$,\\
the external angle adjacent to $\angle C$ is: $180^\circ-110^\circ=70^\circ$,\\
thus $\angle \alpha =360^\circ-70^\circ-120^\circ-120^\circ=\boxed{50^\circ}$.
